description: This bar chart, labeled Figure 2, compares the accuracy or correlation scores of five different models across three distinct tasks: Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow bars), STS Correlation (pink bars), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue bars), as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis lists the five model configurations: “Single-task_baseline,” “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” “Supervised_SimCSE,” and “2-Tier SimCSE.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” ranges from 0 to 0.8 in linear increments, with major gridlines marked at intervals of 0.2. For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing its performance on each of the three tasks. The “Single-task_baseline” model shows the lowest performance across all tasks, with values approximately 0.54 for Sentiment Acc., 0.51 for STS Corr., and 0.79 for Paraphrase Acc. The “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout” model shows moderate performance, with values around 0.53 for Sentiment Acc., 0.58 for STS Corr., and 0.78 for Paraphrase Acc. The “Unsupervised_SimCSE” model shows a significant improvement in STS Corr. (approximately 0.71), while its Sentiment Acc. remains around 0.53 and Paraphrase Acc. is approximately 0.77. The “Supervised_SimCSE” model achieves the highest scores across all tasks, with values approximately 0.50 for Sentiment Acc., 0.80 for STS Corr., and 0.78 for Paraphrase Acc. The “2-Tier SimCSE” model achieves the highest scores across all tasks, with values approximately 0.50 for Sentiment Acc., 0.81 for STS Corr., and 0.78 for Paraphrase Acc. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any specific bars.
